name: Rain Over Glassline
description: The authored opening scene for a newly created character.

steps.title: ARES LOGISTICS RING // 20:00
steps.text: Rain turns the freight lights into long white smears. Rhea and Dax wait beneath Service Gate 6.

steps.title: A CITY YOU ALREADY KNOW
steps.text: You know which awnings hide a knife and which maintenance doors never quite latch. Glassline is cruel, but it has never been a mystery.

steps.title: THE VIEW FROM BELOW
steps.text: The tower credentials in your pocket expired months ago. The habits they bought you did not. Every camera angle still looks like an invitation.

steps.title: RESONANCE
steps.text: The signal should be noise. Instead, its harmonic structure follows the same impossible sequence you once found burned into an ether conduit.

steps.title: THE ARES JOB
steps.text: The camera turns away. For seven seconds, the service door belongs to you.

name: Static Beneath Glass
description: Mira recruits Vane to investigate the sealed annex.

steps.text: “The annex is eating people’s memories,” Mira says. “Sable heard the security band. We need her frequency map.”

choices.text: Take the job and go to the clinic

name: The Clinic Frequency
description: Information scene revealing the hidden station.

steps.text: Sable plays a recording: a human voice trapped beneath a corporate carrier signal.
The map exposes a forgotten station under Glassline and the service route into the annex.

outcome.title: A Route Beneath the Rain
outcome.resultText: The abandoned transit station is now visible on the district map.

steps.text: Ash Crow and two scavengers block the flooded platform. “Pay, turn back, or prove you are not corporate.”

outcome.title: A Narrow Accord
outcome.resultText: Ash parts with enough conductor to build a bypass spike.

steps.text: The old station opens into a cathedral of black glass. Ether-light moves behind the walls like something remembering how to breathe.
The core doors seal. Warden Kest raises a weapon, then hesitates as the ether signal speaks through every pane.
The recovered signal contains erased residents’ identities—and OmniCorp access keys worth a fortune.

choices.text: Sell the keys to the Syndicate

steps.text: Mira nods toward the safehouse. “Whatever we chose, Glassline will feel it by morning.”
By dawn the market whispers your decision. Sable arrives at the safehouse with a medical case and nowhere else to go.
Rain threads through the market holo-signs, turning every face into a shifting mask.
Names scratched into the station tile pulse faintly when the ether storm passes.
Sable quietly gives her last clean bandage to a child and pretends not to notice you watching.
“Camera sweeps every twelve seconds. Stay behind me and don’t silhouette the door.”
“Lock 3 is the point of no return. Until then, quiet tools.”
“Clean loop. They’ll blame the reader before they blame us.”
“Port logged the splice. We keep moving and make the timestamp useless.”

steps.title: INSIDE THE PERIMETER
steps.text: The latch catches behind you. No alarm follows.
“Maintenance booth is live. A route pull now could buy us cover at Lock 3.”
“Baton’s charged. Keep it where you can reach it.”
“Take patches, cells, one weapon. Anything heavier will slow the exit.”

steps.title: A BLIND ANGLE
steps.text: The stolen map exposes a maintenance trench below the checkpoint sightline.

steps.title: SHIFT-NET ACCESS
steps.text: The Maintenance Control breach left a valid service handshake in the lock controller.
“Route is good until the gate cycles. After that, assume every camera is awake.”
“Charges are seated. Say the word and Lock 3 forgets it was closed.”

steps.title: LOCK 3 CYCLING
steps.text: Steel withdraws into the walls. Boots move on the far side.

name: Freight Checkpoint Lockdown
description: The sealed freight approach becomes the first serious fight of the operation.

steps.title: AMBUSH AT LOCK 3
steps.text: The rear gate slams down. Two officers spread across the cargo lane as a sentry drone drops from its cradle.

steps.title: THE MAP WAS RIGHT
steps.text: A narrow loading recess opens exactly where the stolen route promised it would.
“Officers left. Drone high. Don’t let it pin us.”
“I’ll break their line. Move when I move.”

steps.title: ARES SECURITY // ENGAGED
steps.text: The first thermal round cuts through the rain mist.

name: Checkpoint Secured
description: The party crosses into the Ares inner facility after collecting the checkpoint supplies.

steps.text: The route advantage has served its purpose.

steps.title: BEYOND THE PERIMETER
steps.text: The checkpoint keycard releases an inner bulkhead. Past it, the facility is dark—and already damaged.

steps.title: ARES CENTRAL VAULT
steps.text: Dax seals Lock 3 behind you. The air beyond smells of antiseptic and burned insulation.

steps.title: NO MARKS
steps.text: The drones were smashed against the walls. The guards simply fell. Their armor, eyes, and implants show no lethal trauma.

steps.title: OFF THE MAP
steps.text: The stolen security route ends at this hall. Everything below was omitted from the logistics network.
“Machines fought something. People didn’t get the chance.”
“No wounds, no gas alert. Keep your helmets sealed anyway.”

steps.title: PROJECT PALIMPSEST
steps.text: The files describe an interface that responds to attention, memory, and expectation—not commands.

steps.title: INCOMPATIBLE
steps.text: Every contact subject was rejected. The reports record the aftermath, then stop before defining success.

steps.title: FAMILIAR METHODOLOGY
steps.text: The trial notation is careful until the final week. Then every protocol becomes a request for more exposure time.

steps.title: AN INTERNAL BLACK SITE
steps.text: The budget codes are buried under routine logistics—exactly how corporate research hides a project from its own auditors.
“Ares kept putting people in front of it. Whatever answered, they couldn’t shut it back up.”

steps.title: SECURITY ROUTE CONFIRMED
steps.text: The route cache identifies two emergency shutters the Nexus can keep open during withdrawal.

steps.title: PALIMPSEST CONTAINMENT
steps.text: The Annex files mark the vault controls as observational only. Ares never found a command channel.
“This is where we walk away if we’re walking away.”
“I’ll hold the seal. You read the chamber, take nothing you can’t carry, and come back.”

steps.title: CENTRAL VAULT // ACCESS GRANTED
steps.text: The last seal opens without venting air. That is worse than an alarm.

steps.title: THE OBJECT IN THE FRAME
steps.text: A black assembly hangs between magnetic rings. Its edges are machined; its depth does not agree with the room around it.

steps.title: SOUND FALLS AWAY
steps.text: The chamber tone lengthens until it becomes pressure. Rhea moves, then her image follows a heartbeat later.
Don’t let it hear me being afraid.
If the frame breaks, get them behind me.

steps.title: THE MISSING DEFINITION
steps.text: Palimpsest called every subject incompatible. Looking at the object now, you understand the reports were describing refusal.

steps.title: PREDATOR STILLNESS
steps.text: You know the stillness before violence. The chamber has the same stillness, but it is waiting for thought.

steps.title: CONTACT
steps.text: Cold alloy touches your palm. Something meets the shape of your mind—not entering, not speaking, simply recognizing a door.

steps.title: CONTAINMENT FAILURE
steps.text: Sound returns all at once. The frames twist apart and the floor rises in a white concussion.
“Go.”

steps.title: DAX IS GONE
steps.text: The access frame collapses between heartbeats. Rhea drags you toward the emergency route as security boots fill the corridor.

steps.title: RESPONSE LINE
steps.text: Three officers enter through the smoke. A drone floats above them, precise and empty.

steps.title: MINDS IN THE STATIC
steps.text: Human intent brushes your awareness—fear, aim, obedience. The drone gives you nothing at all.
“The officers hesitate when you touch them. The drone won’t. I’ll take it.”

steps.title: FIRST CONTACT UNDER FIRE
steps.text: You reach for the nearest human thought before you know what reaching means.

steps.title: ONE MIND LEFT AWAKE
steps.text: Lieutenant Hale is trapped under a barrier, weapon gone. His fear arrives before his voice does.

steps.title: FIRST CONTACT
steps.text: His thoughts are close enough to touch. That does not make any choice harmless.

choices.text: READ MIND — follow the memory behind his fear.
ERASE MEMORY — remove the last hour.
FORCE SLEEP — put him down without killing him.
COMMAND — try to hold his will.

steps.title: A MEMORY THAT ISN’T YOURS
steps.text: Ares had your entry window and team profile before you crossed Gate 6. Hale saw the packet arrive through an internal dead channel. He never saw who sent it.

steps.title: THE LAST HOUR UNRAVELS
steps.text: Recent memory comes apart under your attention. His name remains. The vault, your faces, and the artifact do not.

steps.title: QUIET
steps.text: You press against wakefulness until it gives way. Hale’s breathing steadies; the fear goes dark.

steps.title: NO SIGNAL
steps.text: The lieutenant dies before his armor reconnects to the response net.

steps.title: A COMMAND, NOT CONTROL
steps.text: You stop one impulse and force one word. Trying to hold more makes both minds buckle. Whatever this is, domination is beyond you.

steps.title: FACILITY FAILURE
steps.text: Shutters grind through smoke. Damaged drones fire at movement while containment alarms contradict one another.
You and Rhea cross the Annex under dead lights. Pursuing minds flare behind you like matches struck in another room.

steps.title: THE LEAK
steps.text: Hale’s stolen memory follows you through the smoke: Ares knew the team was coming.

steps.title: A CLEAN GAP
steps.text: Behind you, Hale wakes without the last hour—and without a face to give Ares.

steps.title: ONE LIFE LEFT BEHIND
steps.text: Hale remains unconscious beneath the barrier, alive when you last feel his mind fade from range.

steps.title: THE LIMIT
steps.text: The failed command leaves a pressure behind your eyes and the certainty that forcing harder would have broken someone.
“They have both signatures. We split at the runoff trench.”
“Go inside when you reach Glassline. I’ll be there.”

steps.title: TWO ROUTES OUT
steps.text: Rhea disappears east into the runoff tunnels. You carry Dax’s silence west.

steps.title: NOTHING TO PUT DOWN
steps.text: The artifact is not in your pack. The resonance answers from behind your own memories, where thought should be private.

steps.title: SAFEHOUSE // 06:10
steps.text: Rain ticks against the shielded windows. Rhea’s channel remains open. The door remains closed.

steps.title: NO HANDSHAKE
steps.text: No courier signature reaches Glassline. No emergency burst. Each connection attempt returns the same empty carrier.

steps.title: EVERY CHANNEL
steps.text: You already checked the courier bands twice. Waiting does not change the answer.

steps.title: ATTENTION
steps.text: When you focus on the bound resonance, something seems to focus back.

steps.title: THE DEAD CHANNEL
steps.text: The stolen memory remains intact: timing, profiles, an internal route—and no sender.

steps.title: A THOUGHT THAT ISN’T YOURS
steps.text: As sleep takes you, your own inner voice says: she is not the only mind that knows where you are.

steps.title: PROLOGUE COMPLETE
steps.text: The Ares job is over. Dax is dead. Rhea is missing. Something came home with you.

steps.title: 3 DAYS LATER // MEGACITY-9
steps.text: Rain moves across the towers. Somewhere in the city, a stranger dreams in a voice you recognize.
